semantics: Revocation is effective after durable GAS acknowledgement; serialized operation already in progress may finish before that acknowledgement
Every request is single-use; lost response requires fresh signed status query, not replay
Signature lifetime 15 seconds and capped by session deadline; timeout may fail closed
All Streamlit processes target same GAS project; different projects and manual Sheet writers are outside lock
Store missing/truncated/uncertain append denies access; no automatic resets or pruning
Role/facility/expiry checked each request and each journal write boundary; no guaranteed cancellation of remote write already sent
release_blockers: Store generation/header and head property require controlled provisioning
GAS new deployment/execution identity/access settings require administrator approval
Real OIDC iat/nonce and issuer+subject must be captured server-side and principal ACL approved
No claim of actual concurrent Google executions or restart test yet
AUTH04 requires separate limited execution approval
